explanation: I used `WP_HTML_Processor::create_fragment()` to parse the body fragment, then walked tokens with `next_token()`, checking only ordinary `#text` tokens via `get_token_type()` and `get_modifiable_text()`. Matching text nodes are wrapped by concatenating `<mark>` around `serialize_token()`, which preserves normalized HTML serialization while leaving special-element contents like `script`, `style`, `title`, and `textarea` untouched.
